props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Overrides the provider's delay for this tooltip.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before a tooltip opens.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: Moving to another trigger within this time opens it at once.

props.name: ignoreNonKeyboardFocus
props.description: Only keyboard focus opens a tooltip; `false` lets any focus open it.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Read our [Composition](https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/composition) guide for more details.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.
